hypothesis: A graph model can choose an initial schedule that leads exact local search to a better local optimum without paying for every restart.
hand_selectors: best refined result from two lowest initial RTTs
selector_registration: Choose the best mean-RTT hand selector on calibration among those with p95 planning time <=2ms; freeze it before qualification. Freeze one globally best fixed initializer on calibration. No per-instance hindsight selection among hand methods.
oracle: minimum final RTT across all twelve fully refined initializers, reported with actual full cost; a headroom ceiling only, not a deployable free selector
training_gate: oracle median paired gain versus frozen deployable hand selector >=5pct and bootstrap median 95pct lower bound >0 on qualification; oracle is granted free selection for this necessary headroom test
if_pass: cost-sensitive GNN selector versus MPoff and strong hand-feature selector; same search, features, data, validation selection, and total planning budget; fresh model test required
if_fail: no training; still complete registered fresh live gate
live_gate: 32 fresh workflows: frozen hand selector, native ECT descent, oracle-best restart plan and actual Knative. Save all searched complete plans and audit real simulator agreement.
scope: initializer selection for this finite portfolio and fixed workflow family, not arbitrary learned search
